Reference / runtime/ordering

runtime/ordering#

The low-level bulk ordering boundary used by collections/ordering.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let ordered = BulkOrdering(values: materialized).items();

Description#

The low-level bulk ordering boundary used by collections/ordering.

The host runtime owns the stable merge sort behind @T.ordering(). This object keeps that intrinsic out of collection decorators and gives stdlib code one explicit dependency for bulk ordering:

T must satisfy Comparing<T>. The returned array is a new value; the input array is unchanged. Equal values retain their input order.

This is a fixed runtime intrinsic rather than a portable bodyless native declaration. The portable native ABI intentionally cannot receive language action callbacks or opaque domain objects, both of which generic Comparing requires. If that ABI gains a safe callback protocol, this module is the single boundary that can move to an external provider.
